source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of semiconductors with Quick Check 31.1 and derived answers (PDF 221).

blocks.text: Semiconductors aise substances hain jo sirf khaas halaat (special conditions) mein bijli guzarte hain, aur roshni (light), garmi (heat) aur voltage se asar lete hain. Isi wajah se yeh modern electronics mein bohat ahem hain. Conductor aur semiconductor mein farq yeh hai ke semiconductor mein guzarne wale current ko zarurat ke mutabiq control kiya ja sakta hai. Sab se aam semiconductor silicon hai; yeh bohat achha kaam karta hai aur bohat zyada miqdar mein milta hai (abundant), is liye microchips aur solar panels mein use hota hai. Mobile ka SIM card silicon chip aur kuch chhote hisson, jaise copper connectors, se bana hota hai. Silicon device mein data guzarne, mehfooz (store) karne aur process karne ke kaam aata hai. Aik aur ahem semiconductor gallium arsenide (GaAs) hai, jo wireless communication, maslan 5G internet devices, mein use hota hai. Gallium nitride (GaN) apni behtar conductivity ki wajah se electric gariyon ki fast charging mein use hota hai.

blocks.prompt: i. Bijli ki taaron (power lines) par ceramics insulators ke taur par kyun use hote hain?
blocks.explanation: Porcelain jaise ceramics bijli nahi guzarte, is liye current taar se khambe tak nahi pohanchta. Yeh sakht, garmi se mehfooz aur chemically inert bhi hain, is liye bahar dhoop aur barish mein bhi der tak chalte hain.

blocks.prompt: ii. Microchips aur solar panels ke liye silicon kyun pasand kiya jata hai?
blocks.explanation: Silicon bohat achha semiconductor hai jis ka current control ho sakta hai, aur yeh bohat zyada miqdar mein milta hai (abundant).

blocks.prompt: iii. Composite materials mein reinforcement agents kya dete hain?
blocks.explanation: Zyada strength (mazbooti); matrix unhein apni jagah pakre rakhta hai.

items: Semiconductors khaas halaat mein bijli guzarte hain; in ka current control ho sakta hai.
Si: microchips, solar panels, SIM card; GaAs: 5G; GaN: electric gariyon ki fast charging.
